ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: the Sump
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
THESUMP_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 23 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). The planet's oil sump: a flat, permanently-dusky black basin filled by every slow flow off the twilight slopes for geological time, ringed with low waxy plants that glow faintly wherever a lamp-garden keeps them alight. Fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign. A separate frozen campaign world's own Sump instance (RUT_Sump, src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches) is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships the biome and its own placement worker (RM_BiomeWorker_TheSump, replacing the donor AlphaBiomes.BiomeWorker_TarPits — a donor type in workerClass is a hard dependency the RimMandrake tier may not assume), plus the tar-basin kit whose C# already lives in the shared RimMandrake: Environmental Hazards Kit (mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards): a poured tar moat with a hand-cranked fuse post that floods ignition across every connected cell of poured or natural tar; a manual-labor dig shaft with a four-stratum salvage lottery, arming traps as it goes deeper; a dormant tar-beast set-piece that wakes on damage or nearby construction; a sump-mouse placeholder whose faint tracks telegraph where something else has been through first; a wick-garden crop that needs no sun, only whatever faint ambient light the permanent dusk and station lamps provide; and a permanent-dusk weather lock (never rains, never fully dark or light). Ships 4 wildlife rows inline, all individually MayRequire-gated Alpha Animals donor rows. A Mod Settings screen gives a worldgen-rarity master toggle (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine — default = shipped behavior, 0 = never generates); the kit mechanics' own per-mechanic toggles live partly on the shared Environmental Hazards Kit's own settings screen (tar coating, tarred hediff, glasswalk slip, warbling glow, glow multiplier — shared with Greentide and Miasma) and partly nowhere yet (moat ignition, dig lottery, beast-bulge dread, mouse filth-trail have no toggle at all today) — a second, Sump-only copy of the covered ones here would either do nothing or silently diverge from what that screen already promises.
⚠️ Not donor-free: the world-map texture (Biomes/AB_TarPits), both terrainsByFertility rows (AB_GrassySand/AB_LushGrass) and one wildPlants row (AB_TarPuddle) are all Alpha Biomes' own, so sarg.alphabiomes ships as a hard modDependency rather than an optional MayRequire — without it this biome has almost no terrain or flora. The dormant tar-beast building, the dig-shaft, the moat/fuse-post, the sump-mouse placeholder, the mouse-track filth and the wick-plant/wick-stem all still carry DEPLOY_HOLD (no real art yet, see src/DEPLOY_HOLD.txt) — content proven to compile and wire correctly, not yet visually shipped.
NOT in this mod: RSW_Hssiss (the biome's one seated canon beast) rides a Utinni patch (WildAnimals_Sump.xml) onto this mod's own RM_TheSump def instead, per the Q11a naming-tier ruling (SUMP_UTINNI_LAYER_1 §3). The Sumpgas rename, the flame- statue's holy-act-to-the-evil-sun-god ideoligion meaning, and the Junker-station campaign labels are SUMP_UTINNI_LAYER_1's own campaign-tier work, not this mod's; the tar coating/tarred hediff/surgery/solvents/thoughts content and the Walkways/ Bitumen/Sumpgas/Gaslight kit content (all shipped 2026-09-24) are not biome-gated and stay in mandrake.rut.patches for now.
Live proof (step 5, a scratch-world quicktest with all five expansions) is Desktop-only and OWED — see the item's own verify record.
